lists.name: 1001 Albums You Must Hear Before You Die

podcast.body: Released after a quick tour of Japan in 1978, this live record transformed Cheap Trick into massive stars on both sides of the Pacific. Its success significantly advanced the Powerpop genre, setting the stage for New Wave bands to embrace the sound. "Later that year, they flew over for a quick tour and the resulting record, cheap trick at Budacan, made the massive stars on both sides of the Pacific."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
